criteria.interpretation: Provisional engineering criteria, not scientific standards or source certification. Missing availability criterion or inadequate clean quality cannot be hidden by survivor accuracy.
criteria.uncertainty: Paired60s temporal-block bootstrap within half,200resamples; per-match/seed curves. Overlapping windows are not independent; two retrospective matches not population certification.

warning: Empirical discrete tested levels only; do not interpolate safety thresholds. Seed variation and paired block intervals in sensitivity_metrics.json.
